fact: In a page dated Bissau 16 May 2023 the INE president describes the INE as the central body of the SEN defined in Lei n.º 6/2007 and says the complementary rules to that law are inadequate, so the SEN legal framework will soon be revised.
title: INE - Palavras do Presidente
publisher: Instituto Nacional de Estatística da Guiné-Bissau
